factory: Fábrica de Tabacos Joya de Nicaragua S.A.
about: Joya de Nicaragua's 55th anniversary cigar, a soft-pressed blend with a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. The blend was built from the records of hundreds of blending sessions held with factory visitors, and it sits in the company's top Obras Maestras tier.
notes: The maker's page rates strength 4 out of 5 and calls it medium to full-bodied, but its launch release said full-bodied with medium strength, and halfwheel found the strength mild to medium. A 6 x 60 size was made in 2024 as a TAA exclusive.
verifyNotes: Checked against the maker's product page and launch post and two halfwheel reviews. Nothing changed.

factory: Fábrica de Tabacos Joya de Nicaragua S.A.
